## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the concrete trigger, what happened before, and what happens after this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run smoke`

## Review checklist

- [ ] Based on current `main`
- [ ] Includes a regression for behavioural fixes
- [ ] Preserves tool-call pairing and recent-node protection
- [ ] Updates user documentation/configuration tables when behaviour changes
- [ ] Links `Fixes #N` only when the issue is fully resolved
